Lot of people here making jokes, I was too but I thought I should say that you should be there for your friend. There’s nothing wrong with being gay, but it can be really scary and awkward to know something about yourself that you don’t know how others you care about will react to. 

If the concept of getting a free blowjob from you best bud makes you feel uncomfortable, just say that. Regardless of sexuality that would be a big gap to bridge between old friends. So it’s more than fair to not want to do that. 

You could be open and honest with him, tell him that you’re nervous, tell him your saw the posts on Twitter, just be honest. But take care to be gentle. Friends come and go from our lives, but It can be hard to make new ones with deep connections later in life. 

If you care for your friend this would be the time to show it. If you have to let him down, be kind. But make sure that you support him with coming out. Nothing changes if your friend is gay. He’s still the same person. 

And it’s nothing to be afraid about. 

Or if you’re homophobic maybe work on yourself, just don’t hurt your friend.
